result.opinion_quote: In our opinion, in all material respects, the description presents the system as designed and implemented, and the controls stated in the description were suitably designed and operated effectively throughout the period, except for the deviations described in Section 4, which did not, in our judgment, rise to a level that would modify our opinion.

exceptions.description: Selected 25 of 112 administrative accounts and inspected MFA enrollment and enforcement configuration. Exception noted. 4 of 25 sampled admin accounts were not enforced for MFA. These were service-desk accounts created via a legacy provisioning script that bypassed the conditional access policy.
exceptions.management_response: Management disabled the legacy provisioning script in April 2026 and has begun migrating service-desk accounts to the standard conditional access policy. Migration expected to complete Q3 2026.

exceptions.description: Selected 15 of 64 terminations; compared termination date from HR system to access removal date. Exception noted. 3 of 15 terminated users retained active access for 6, 11, and 19 business days respectively.
exceptions.management_response: Management is evaluating an automated HR-to-IdP de-provisioning integration. Until then, terminations are processed manually by IT upon email notification from HR.

exceptions.description: Selected 30 days and inspected alert review evidence. Exception noted. For 2 consecutive weeks (Nov 10–23, 2025), alerts were forwarded to a decommissioned distribution list and were not reviewed.
exceptions.management_response: The distribution list was corrected on November 24, 2025. Management has added a weekly check that alert routing is functioning.

exceptions.description: Selected 40 of 1,288 production changes; inspected approval records. Exception noted. 2 of 40 changes lacked documented approval (emergency hotfixes).
exceptions.management_response: Management has updated the emergency change procedure to require post-deployment approval within 48 hours.
